title: Bitcoin plunges below $59,000 as rush to cash puts new bear market lows back in play
content: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

title: Former Point72 head of proprietary research says AI could turn data into a new asset class for Wall Street
content: A former Point72 executive says AI could reshape Wall Street's data market, turning once-exclusive information into a source of revenue and financing.

title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
content: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
content: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $60,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
content: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
content: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
content: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.

title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
content: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
content: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
content: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
content: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.

title: Google Gives Gemini Control of Mac Apps, But Its New AI Agent Comes With Risks
content: Gemini's new Mac computer-use feature navigates apps, files, and websites in a separate window, but Google's own documentation warns about prompt injection.

title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
content: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $60K as Crypto Fear Index Hits Worst Level Since February
content: Bitcoin broke below $60,000 Friday as crypto sentiment collapsed and AI-linked stocks sank after Anthropic’s IPO.

title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
content: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.

title: Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal
content: Bitcoin Magazine Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal Blockstream researchers published a 131-page security analysis of SHRINCS, a hash-based post-quantum signature scheme for Bitcoin, and are asking the community to review it for flaws. This post Researchers Publish Security Analysis of Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum SHRINCS Proposal first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike
content: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Fed not to embrace a bigger rate hike as Citi and traders still see a quarter-point move in December and bitcoin fell below $60,000. This post U.S. Treasury Secretary Pushes Back on Bigger Fed Hike first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens Bitcoin fell below $60,000 for the first time since early July on Friday as a tech stock rout, rate hike bets and record ETF outflows hit risk assets. This post Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food
content: Bitcoin Magazine Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food Block’s first bitcoin payments report found the median Square payment is about $13, with 72% at food and drink businesses, as it pushes for a de minimis tax exemption. This post Block Says Most Bitcoin Payments on Square Are for Coffee and Food first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping Bitcoin is trading barely above its realized price, the average cost of every coin, and a break below would put the average holder at a loss for the first time since early 2023. This post Bitcoin Hovers Just Above Average Holder’s Cost Basis as Price Keeps Dipping first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
